# Dyer's Plumbing, Inc.

> > Professional plumbing and air services serving Eden, NC, Salem, and surrounding North Carolina and Virginia areas with expertise in residential, commercial, and industrial plumbing solutions.

Dyer's Plumbing, Inc. (also known as Dyer's Plumbing & Air) provides comprehensive plumbing services including water heater maintenance, drain cleaning, hydro jetting, and emergency plumbing for homes and commercial facilities. The company specializes in preventative maintenance and offers both DIY guidance and professional services throughout the region.
